title: Resetting a forgotten password
ask: Tap through the screenshots of the running app. Judge each step: is it what should happen?
afterwards: Steps you agree with ship as shown. Anything else I change and send back as a new round.

brief.question: Should the app say the same thing whether or not the email has an account?
brief.explains: These are screenshots of the app as it runs today, with sample data. Saying "if this email has an account" for every address means nobody can use the form to find out who is signed up.
brief.recommendation: Keep the same message for every address, and say how long the link works.
risks: Someone who typed the wrong address waits for an email that never comes.
